snippet.title: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Co-op mode is coming to Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition. Check out the Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition gameplay trailer for the real-time strategy game to learn about this new feature. Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition will be available on PC via Steam on July 15, 2025.
